title: MV Show State Name Instead of Icon

posts.author: Myst648
posts.body:
I'm looking for a way to display the full name of a state instead of just the icon. If the character has no state, it would just say "Normal." This would be virtually identical to the system in 2003 as seen below:
Preferably, I would also want it to have a "scroll" effect where if the character has multiple states, the display would switch every few seconds to accommodate.
